itineraries.title: Art by Day, Beach Music by Night in Raleigh
itineraries.theme: A free-leaning Raleigh Thursday from museum galleries to an outdoor beach-music concert
itineraries.drive_time: Everything within ~15 min around Raleigh; NCMA to North Hills is ~12 min
itineraries.cost_range: $0–$40 (tour free; concert + dinner are the spend)
itineraries.overview: Ease into the week with a free docent tour at the NC Museum of Art, cool off through the afternoon, then catch The Pink Slips at North Hills' Thursday beach-music series. It tops 96°F, so bank the hot midday hours indoors and hydrate before the evening show.

afternoon.title: Public Tour: The People's Collection
afternoon.location: North Carolina Museum of Art, 2110 Blue Ridge Rd, Raleigh
afternoon.notes: Free 50-minute docent tour; the museum's air conditioning is the best midday move on a 96°F day.

evening.title: The Pink Slips — Midtown Beach Music Series
evening.location: Midtown Park at North Hills, 4011 Cardinal at North Hills St, Raleigh
evening.notes: Outdoor shag/beach-music concert 6–9 p.m. Bring a low chair; food and drinks available on-site.

evening.title: Room 861 at Goodnights: Bobby Jaycox (optional late laugh)
evening.location: Goodnights Comedy Club, 401 Woodburn Rd, Raleigh
evening.notes: If you'd rather end indoors, swap the concert's back half for a stand-up set 10 min away.

food.vegan_dish: The 'Sunny Bowl' with tofu, greens and tahini
food.notes: Fast, cold, plant-forward — good fuel before the heat peaks.
Fully vegetarian/vegan on W Martin St; reserve ahead, then head to North Hills.

alternatives.good_weather: Full outdoor set at Midtown Park
alternatives.rain: Pop-up storms are possible late — if it turns, duck into the North Hills shops/restaurants or pivot to the indoor Goodnights show.

practical_notes: 96°F and humid — carry water and plan the museum for the hottest part of the afternoon.
North Hills has free garage parking; arrive by 5:30 p.m. for a good lawn spot.
NCMA is closed Mondays but open Thursday; the tour meets in the main lobby.

itineraries.title: Bull City Friday: Barbecue & Blackberry Smoke
itineraries.theme: A downtown Durham evening built around a marquee DPAC concert
itineraries.drive_time: All within a 10-min walk/drive of downtown Durham

weather.summary: Sunny then Chance Showers and Thunderstorms

itineraries.overview: Make a night of it in downtown Durham: an early dinner in the American Tobacco district, then Blackberry Smoke's Rattle, Ramble and Roll Tour with special guest Jason Newsted at DPAC. A hot, storm-capable afternoon means everything here is walkable and mostly indoors.

evening.title: Early dinner in the American Tobacco Campus
evening.location: American Tobacco Campus, Durham (adjacent to DPAC)
evening.notes: Park once in the ATC decks and walk to the show.

evening.title: Blackberry Smoke: Rattle, Ramble and Roll Tour
evening.location: Durham Performing Arts Center, 123 Vivian St, Durham
evening.notes: Doors 7 p.m., show 8 p.m.; special guest Jason Newsted (ex-Metallica).

food.vegan_dish: Vegetable bibimbap, no egg (gochujang on the side)
food.vegetarian_dish: Kimchi fried rice with a fried egg
food.notes: If Namu is full, Tobacco Road Sports Café and Mellow Mushroom (vegan cheese available) are steps away.

alternatives.good_weather: Stroll the ATC waterway before doors
alternatives.rain: Storms are possible after sunset — the ATC decks connect under cover to DPAC, so you can stay dry.

practical_notes: DPAC is all-ages but everyone needs a ticket; children under 6 aren't admitted to this show.
97°F day — the venue and campus are air-conditioned; dress light.
Buy parking ahead in an ATC deck on a concert night.

itineraries.title: Chapel Hill to Carrboro: ArtWalk & Indie Rock
itineraries.theme: A college-town Friday pairing free gallery hours with a Cat's Cradle Back Room show
itineraries.drive_time: Ackland to Cat's Cradle is ~8 min; both walkable from Franklin St / downtown Carrboro

weather.summary: Sunny then Chance Showers and Thunderstorms

itineraries.cost_range: $15–$45 (ArtWalk free; show + dinner are the spend)
itineraries.overview: Start with free extended hours and 2nd Friday ArtWalk at UNC's Ackland Art Museum, graze dinner in Carrboro, then catch a local triple bill in the intimate Cat's Cradle Back Room. Everything is close and mostly indoor-friendly if storms roll through.

afternoon.title: 2nd Friday ArtWalk — Extended Museum Hours
afternoon.location: Ackland Art Museum, 101 S Columbia St, Chapel Hill
afternoon.notes: Galleries stay open 5–9 p.m.; free admission, air-conditioned, family-friendly.

evening.title: Johnny Sunrise and the Clouds, With Love, Nicole Tester
evening.location: Cat's Cradle Back Room, 300 E Main St, Carrboro
evening.notes: Doors 7 p.m., show 8 p.m. The Back Room is a small, standing-room space.

food.vegan_dish: Vegan mac from the hot bar + a kombucha
food.vegetarian_dish: Margherita slice and a big garden salad
food.notes: Co-op grocery + lawn a block from Cat's Cradle; grab-and-go and eat on the Town Commons.

alternatives.good_weather: Walk Franklin/Main St between Chapel Hill and Carrboro
alternatives.rain: If it pours, both the Ackland and the Back Room are indoors — just drive the 8 minutes between them.

practical_notes: Park in the Wallace Deck (Chapel Hill) for the Ackland; street/lot parking in Carrboro for the show.
The Back Room sells out small shows — buy the etix ticket in advance.
97°F and humid; the ArtWalk is the cool, free anchor of the evening.

itineraries.title: Super Saturday Raleigh: Market, Museums & a Legend
itineraries.theme: A full Raleigh Saturday from the farmers market to a bucket-list concert, with storm backups
itineraries.drive_time: State Farmers Market, NCMA and downtown all within ~15 min

weather.summary: Partly Sunny then Showers and Thunderstorms Likely

itineraries.cost_range: $25–$120 (markets/museums free; evening concert is the splurge)
itineraries.overview: Beat the heat early at the State Farmers Market, spend the storm-likely afternoon in the free, air-conditioned NC Museum of Art, browse a pop-up market, then choose your big Saturday night — Gladys Knight downtown or Paul Simon at the amphitheater. Afternoon thunderstorms are likely, so the indoor museum block is the weather hedge.

morning.title: NC State Farmers Market
morning.location: State Farmers Market, 1201 Agriculture St, Raleigh
morning.notes: Peak produce and a hot breakfast at the market restaurant before the day heats up.

afternoon.title: The Market at Raleigh Iron Works
afternoon.notes: Small-business pop-up, 11 a.m.–4 p.m. — do this before storms build.

afternoon.title: The Altered Environment + Becoming the NCMA (Exhibitions)
afternoon.location: North Carolina Museum of Art, 2110 Blue Ridge Rd, Raleigh
afternoon.notes: Two free exhibitions and cool galleries — the ideal place to be when the afternoon storms hit.

evening.title: Gladys Knight
evening.location: Raleigh Memorial Auditorium, 2 E South St, Raleigh
evening.notes: Indoor, downtown, weatherproof. Prefer an amphitheater? Paul Simon plays Coastal Credit Union Music Park the same night (id 3d0ea02dffb1).

food.vegan_dish: Grits, home fries and fruit (ask for no butter on the grits)
food.notes: Classic market breakfast right where you're already shopping.
Spice-forward Indian/Asian on Fayetteville St; strong vegetarian menu.
Laotian downtown, walkable to Raleigh Memorial Auditorium; book ahead on a concert night.

alternatives.good_weather: Browse Raleigh Iron Works outdoors, then the museum
alternatives.rain: If storms come early, flip the order — go to the NCMA first and shop the market in a dry window.

alternatives.good_weather: Paul Simon under the stars at the amphitheater
alternatives.rain: Storms likely — the indoor Gladys Knight show is the safe pick; amphitheater shows go on rain or shine but bring a poncho.

practical_notes: Thunderstorms are likely after midday — keep the indoor museum block flexible.
Downtown decks (Wilmington/Blount) are easiest for the evening auditorium show.
93°F with high humidity; the morning market and evening indoor show bracket the worst heat.

itineraries.title: Cary Saturday: Farmers Market to a Courage Kickoff
itineraries.theme: A Western-Wake family Saturday capped by pro women's soccer
itineraries.drive_time: Morrisville market, downtown Cary and WakeMed Soccer Park all within ~15 min

weather.summary: Partly Sunny then Showers and Thunderstorms Likely

itineraries.overview: Do a laid-back west-side Saturday: morning at the Western Wake Farmers Market, an air-conditioned midday break, then an evening NWSL match as the NC Courage host the Washington Spirit at WakeMed Soccer Park. Storms are likely mid-afternoon, so keep the middle of the day indoors.

morning.title: Western Wake Farmers Market
morning.location: Indian Creek Trailhead Park, 101 Town Hall Dr, Morrisville
morning.notes: Producer-only market, 8 a.m.–noon; go early before the heat.

afternoon.title: Midday AC break / lunch in downtown Cary
afternoon.notes: Duck the afternoon storms with a long lunch and browse the shops on Academy St.

evening.title: NC Courage vs. Washington Spirit
evening.location: WakeMed Soccer Park, 201 Soccer Park Dr, Cary
evening.notes: NWSL kickoff 6:30 p.m.; general-admission berms are great for families.

food.notes: Downtown Cary has strong South Indian vegetarian options — perfect on a hot day.

food.place: Concession stands / food trucks at WakeMed Soccer Park
food.vegan_dish: Veggie tacos or a soft pretzel
food.notes: Eat at the match so you don't lose your seat before kickoff.

alternatives.good_weather: Berm seating and a full 90 in the open air
alternatives.rain: Storms are likely — check @NCCourage for weather holds; bring a poncho (umbrellas are restricted).

practical_notes: 93°F and storm-capable; the market is a morning-only window.
WakeMed Soccer Park parking is on-site; arrive ~45 min before kickoff.
Berm tickets are the family-friendly, budget pick.

itineraries.title: Slow Durham Sunday: Treasure Hunt & Galleries
itineraries.theme: A relaxed, budget Sunday of vintage shopping and free art in Durham
itineraries.drive_time: Durham Central Park to the Nasher is ~10 min
itineraries.overview: Take it easy: hunt for vintage and local goods at Durham Central Park's Bull City Treasure Hunt, brunch downtown, then cool off with free exhibitions at Duke's Nasher Museum. It's cooler (88°F) but scattered storms are possible, so the museum is a nice back-half backup.

morning.title: Bull City Treasure Hunt
morning.location: Durham Central Park, 501 Foster St, Durham
morning.notes: 40+ vendors and live music; go early for the best finds and cooler temps.

afternoon.title: Tall Tales and Short Stories (Exhibition)
afternoon.location: Nasher Museum of Art at Duke, 2001 Campus Dr, Durham
afternoon.notes: Free, air-conditioned galleries and a lovely café — ideal if afternoon storms bubble up.

food.vegan_dish: Avocado toast on house sourdough (no butter)
food.notes: Shady biergarten patio on the west side of downtown.
Eat at the museum to stay in the AC through the storm window.

alternatives.good_weather: Full lap of the Treasure Hunt + Central Park
alternatives.rain: If it storms early, shift to the Nasher first, then catch the market in a dry window before it closes.

practical_notes: 88°F with scattered storms — the coolest day of the week, but keep a rain plan.
Free parking around Durham Central Park on Sundays; the Nasher has a free lot.
The Nasher is closed Mondays but open Sunday afternoons.

itineraries.title: Midweek Raleigh: SNL Stand-Up & Craft Beer
itineraries.theme: A low-key Wednesday of trivia, brews and a big-name comedy set
itineraries.drive_time: Downtown Raleigh to Goodnights is ~8 min; Bond Brothers (Cary) is ~20 min
itineraries.overview: Break up the week with a proper night out: a laid-back brewery-district dinner, then SNL cast member James Austin Johnson doing stand-up at Goodnights. Free trivia and music bingo around town make good warm-ups. It's a hot, dry, sunny day — patios are back in play after a stormy stretch.

evening.title: NC Team Trivia at Bond Brothers (optional warm-up)
evening.location: Bond Brothers Beer Company, 202 E Cedar St, Cary
evening.notes: Free weekly trivia at 7 p.m. if you want a pre-show pint; Music Bingo at Ponysaurus in Durham (id 45e515c411bb) is the east-side alternative.

evening.title: James Austin Johnson
evening.location: Goodnights Comedy Club, 401 Woodburn Rd, Raleigh
evening.notes: SNL cast member; 18+ with a two-item minimum in the showroom. Buy ahead.

food.vegan_dish: Impossible burger with fries (ask for a vegan bun)
food.vegetarian_dish: Pimento-cheese sandwich and a local draft
food.notes: Historic Raleigh pub minutes from Goodnights; big draft list.

alternatives.good_weather: Patio pint at Bond Brothers or a Village District dinner
alternatives.rain: Clear, sunny evening forecast — but Goodnights and the breweries are all indoor if plans change.

practical_notes: 95°F and sunny — a good patio night after the mid-week storms.
Goodnights is 18+; arrive 30 min early for the two-item-minimum seating.
If you skip the Cary trivia, go straight to a Village District dinner near the club.
